summary: Ran a fresh isolated headless Chrome session against https://autopilot.local/ with no form submission, cart mutation, order placement or message sending. At 1440 px the primary mega-menu started hidden with aria-expanded=false, opened visibly with aria-expanded=true and body state applied, retained exactly one selected category and one pressed crop after real clicks, then closed with Escape and restored aria-expanded=false. At 390 px the visible mobile toggler opened a visible active menu with body overflow locked, then closed it and restored body overflow. Both sessions returned HTTP 200 and emitted no page errors.
